records: Binance's $6.3B figure is its estimated incident impact; Binance's Oct 30 statement does not publish a final stolen-loss audit. TRM's $6.36B is an independent provider's on-chain attribution/valuation at transfer time, not Binance's completed postmortem.
TRM's 233.46M XRP figure is a provider-reported trace from five Binance XRPL wallets. The attacker address remained static only through TRM's 00:30 UTC Oct 30 cutoff; later movement is not ruled out.

The five XRP source wallets were not cross-referenced against Binance's Oct 1 PoR address set. The 100.77% XRP reserve ratio is secondary reporting of a pre-incident snapshot; no post-incident XRP coverage ratio is established.

Ripple's broader approximately $200M assistance figure is attributed to Binance co-CEO Yi He. TRM specifically confirms 40.5M RLUSD frozen onchain and RLUSD frozen in a compromised Binance wallet; the full $200M asset composition and valuation are not reconciled.

Stablecoin freezes are restrictions on transfers, not proof of recovery, reissuance, restitution or customer reimbursement. Binance's promise to cover losses is a company statement pending the updated PoR and postmortem.

Reuters' TraderTraitor attribution report relies on TRM's assessment; it is not an independent second blockchain trace. AP independently reports Binance's official incident statement but does not verify the 233.46M XRP figure.
TradRadar's 01:00 and 04:35 UTC snapshots are rolling-window provider aggregates. Account long/short ratios are not notional exposure; funding and OI are not venue-normalized across all instruments.

ETF trackers cover different fund universes and settlement cutoffs. Alpha Finance's XRP-specific 30-session figure differs from its cross-asset overview; XRP Insights' Oct 29 row is provisional and CryptoETF.today had only 2/5 funds reported.

DefiLlama TVL, stablecoin supply, DEX volume, addresses and transaction counters are different metrics. Stablecoin supply growth does not establish native XRP acquisition or proportional settlement demand.

Coinbase's 5.84B tracked XRP wallet balance includes publicly labeled custody/cold wallets and some reserves; it is not Coinbase proprietary inventory. No post-Binance customer migration or XRP net inflow is measured.
CoinDesk's Q2 2026 XRPL metrics are historical and partly attributed to Evernorth; accounts are not persons and the data do not prove institutional substitution for retail users.
Reuters BOJ, Treasury-yield, dollar and oil observations are macro context only. No causal coefficient or event-study separates those factors from the Binance incident.
